@reconnecting.description: The home view's banner while a dropped session is retried.

@removeComputer.description: Context menu item on a home-view card, removing the saved connection.

@addComputer.description: The last card of the home view, and the title of its form.

lastConnected: Last connected {when, date, medium} {when, time, short}
usernamePlaceholder: If the server asks for one
legacyBandwidthWarning: Legacy MJPEG can use 5–20× the bandwidth of H.264 at similar quality. Prefer ARD High Performance or H.264 over RFB on anything but a wired LAN.

@fetchClipboard.description: Session menu button: fetches the clipboard text the server announced into the local clipboard.

@downloadFile.description: Session menu button: opens the remote-path form for an ARD file download.

@downloadTitle.description: Title of the form asking for a path on the Mac.

@remotePath.description: Text field label: absolute path of the file or folder to download.

@downloadDone.description: Transfer row state after a download finished.

@transfers.description: Session panel heading over the list of file transfers.

@transferMore.description: Name of an upload of several dropped items.

@transferQueued.description: Transfer row state: queued behind another transfer.

@transferRunning.description: Transfer row state: bytes are moving.

@transferFile.description: Transfer row: which file of an upload is being sent.

@transferAsking.description: Transfer row state: a name conflict dialog is open.

transferInterrupted: Interrupted; continues when the connection is back

@transferInterrupted.description: Transfer row state: the connection dropped; the transfer resumes after the automatic reconnect.

@transferSent.description: Transfer row state after an upload finished.

transferNothingSaved: Nothing saved: every item was skipped

@transferNothingSaved.description: Transfer row state: a download whose every item was skipped in the conflict dialog.

@transferFailed.description: Transfer row state when a transfer fails.

err.example: rfb: file copy ended with error 5

@transferFilesFailed.description: Transfer row state when some files of an upload failed.

@transferNoFiles.description: Transfer row state: the dropped items held no regular files.

@transferClosed.description: Transfer row state: the session ended for good before the transfer finished.

@transferBytes.description: Transfer row: bytes moved of the total.

@transferResume.description: Transfer row button: go on with an interrupted transfer now.

@transferRetry.description: Transfer row button: send the files that failed again; a download keeps the files it already has.

@transferRenamed.description: Transfer row note: the Mac cannot overwrite, so it stored an uploaded file under a free name.

transferRenamedMore: {n} files saved under other names (the names were taken)

@transferRenamedMore.description: Transfer row note: the Mac stored several uploaded files under free names; n is 2 or more.

transferPartial: Incomplete copy left on the Mac: {name}

@transferPartial.description: Transfer row note: a file whose upload was interrupted or canceled stays on the Mac, incomplete.

transferPartialMore: {n} incomplete copies left on the Mac

@transferPartialMore.description: Transfer row note: several interrupted or canceled uploads stay on the Mac, incomplete; n is 2 or more.

conflictTitle: An item with this name already exists

@conflictMessage.description: Name conflict dialog while placing a download.

@conflictKeepBoth.description: Name conflict button: save the download as “name (2)”.

secureOnly: Refuse None, VNC auth, Plain and other weak types

@dynamicResolution.description: Session panel and settings: the remote desktop's resolution follows the window's size, as in macOS Screen Sharing.

dynamicResolutionRefused: This computer cannot change its resolution, so the picture is scaled to fit the window.

@dynamicResolutionRefused.description: Session panel hint after the server refused dynamic resolution.

@statsDropped.description: Stats HUD, High Performance: pictures decoded but not shown.

@highPerformance.description: Settings: ask a Mac for its HEVC/H.264 media stream; applies on (re)connect.

@videoDecoding.description: Settings: where High Performance and H.264 video is decoded; applies on (re)connect. Choices: Auto, videoDecodingHardware, videoDecodingSoftware.

@decoderHardware.description: Stats HUD and session panel: video is decoded on this GPU.

@decoderFallback.description: Video decoding was asked of the GPU but falls back to the CPU.

hpOtherViewer: High Performance unavailable: another viewer is using this Mac's High Performance stream. Using Standard mode.
hpNoMedia: High Performance media did not arrive. A router with NAT between this PC and the Mac is likely blocking it (the Mac sends UDP 5900/5901 to the address it sees); an SSH tunnel cannot carry it either. High Performance needs a direct UDP path. Using Standard mode.
hpNoDecoder: High Performance unavailable: this PC has no {codec} decoder (for HEVC, install the HEVC Video Extensions). Using Standard mode.
hpRefused: High Performance unavailable: the Mac refused the media stream (error type {type}, sub-code {code}). Using Standard mode.
hpUnavailable: High Performance unavailable: {reason}. Using Standard mode.

@statsDecodeCap.description: HUD line while High Performance caps the bitrate because this PC's decoder cannot keep up.

statsFrameRate30: Decoder-limited: asking the Mac for 30 fps

@statsFrameRate30.description: HUD line once the viewer asks for 30 pictures a second from the next media offer on.

statsCache: Tile cache {hits} hit/{misses} miss, CopyRect {copy}, cursor {cursor}

@statsLink.description: Throughput estimate and fence round trip; rtt is a dash before one is measured.

statsRequested: Asked {name}{auto, select, yes { (auto)} other {}}, quality {quality}, {colour, select, full {full colour} other {256 colours}}

@statsRequested.description: What MyVNC asks the server for: preferred encoding, JPEG quality level (a dash for none), colour depth.

@titleSession.description: The title bar during a session: desktop name, app, security type, encryption.

hostKeyMessage: This is the first connection to {addr}. Its key fingerprint is {fingerprint}. Make sure it is the server's before you accept.
unencryptedMessage: {addr} uses {kind}: the password and everything you type are not protected from anyone on the network between you and the server.
errUnencryptedCanceled: Canceled: the connection is not encrypted.
